## Checklist

- [ ] For larger features, I coordinated with the maintainer in advance (per the Git Flow
      branching conventions described in `README.md`) and this PR targets the appropriate
      feature branch.
- [ ] I ran `dart format --line-length 100 .` at the project root and it made no further changes.
- [ ] I ran `flutter analyze .` at the project root and it reports no new issues.
- [ ] If persistence/model code was regenerated, I re-ran
      `dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` followed by `dart format .`.
- [ ] I tested this change locally (and, if relevant, against a physical fitness machine).
